rationale: Price is sitting at 88% of today's range, just 0.87% below the session high of $14.38, with the last five 1-minute candles showing extremely tight, low-volume consolidation — no directional momentum or breakout confirmation in either direction. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.93%, VIXY +5.14%), which creates headwinds for a long near the high, while the stock has already gapped up 1.55% and run significantly from the prior close, making a short against strong relative volume (4.82x) and price above VWAP and 9-EMA equally risky. With no clear edge in either direction and price stalling near resistance, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
